sloka: एवमुक्तो महातेजा द्युतिमान् दृढविक्रमः ।अब्रवीत् त्रिदशश्रेष्ठं रामो धर्मभृतां वरः ।। ६.१२१.१३ ।।
transliteration: evamukto mahātejā dyutimān dṛḍhavikramaḥ ।abravīt tridaśaśreṣṭhaṁ rāmo dharmabhṛtāṁ varaḥ ।। 6.121.13 ।।

translations.english: "That Sita is auspicious and has surely not done any sin is known to three worlds. But she lived long in the gynaeceum of Ravana."
